scores.note: ambition matches the paragraph's own closing idea; greed leans to wealth, covetousness is formal but apt. 3 lust, 6 hunger, 7 thirst alone read as sexual/literal senses without 'for power'; 4 desire, 8 yearning, 9 craving, 10 longing lose both power and excess, so the sentence changes meaning. Mostly near-copies of 'desire'.
